info.name: TripMind REST API Collection
info.description:
Comprehensive automated test and edge-case collection for TripMind's backend REST API.

Covers:
1. Health & Infrastructure
2. Authentication & Sessions
3. User Profile
4. Trips CRUD & Query Filters
5. AI Itinerary Generation
6. Embedded Activity Lifecycle
7. Public Cryptographic Sharing
8. Destination Discovery
9. Rate Limiting, Security Headers & Edge Errors

All requests assert HTTP status codes and standardized JSON response envelopes.
